Only correction rows are excluded from the chain inventory. Requested year, current reporting status, presence of RF facts and amendment count never filter eligible originals. A missing or invalid legacy anchor rejects the whole new projection; a trusted empty scope has an explicit zero count.

The Governance application reads through one guarded owner transaction. A separate Postgres adapter reads through its caller-held connection. Both use one additive strict payload decoder; missing, malformed or incomplete data never falls back to the old reader.

Only the Governance workflow executor receives the new reader grant. The RF grant/consumer remains separate. Retentive rollback removes only the new grant and keeps definitions and history; exact role/schema authority is restored.
Successor registration, predecessor fixture restoration and empty-only teardown support the ordered 22/23/24-function topology. Populated history prevents teardown.
